posts.author: John Klayer
posts.content_md: My 315 started acting goofy tonight, I guess it is getting ready to kick the bucket. Looking at the beam on the wall a few feet away I see the beam spot and speckle around it and a streak at 45 degrees flickering. It never did that before. I tried turning it off and back on again but it acts the same. I shot 8 test holograms before I noticed the flicker and all of them were very weak. Has anyone else had a 315 act like this? Any ideas how to fix it? Thanks

posts.author: DJ Mathson
posts.content_md: I have a 315M where the beam spot is flickering and never reach the full output during ramp up. Sam Goldwasser suggested it could be a faulty resistor on the laser head, and when I measured the resistance it was not the correct value. I suggest you contact Sam to see if he has any idea of what can be wrong with your laser, either through the discussion group alt.lasers, or through Sam's Laser FAQ.

posts.author: John Klayer
posts.content_md: It healed itself. It quit blinking, it is putting out more power and I just made a great hologram.
